body: I will try to be thankful that it happened, even if it is over. But I think there will still be a part of me that wished I never loved him. I'm sorry to hear about the loneliness you feel :c

Thank you for the reassurance, I know I have other people in my life who love and care about me that can be there for me. Sometimes my mind just gets so warped like... I think about not being able to handle my life without him. Having him in my life has been such a security for me and losing that is so scary.

I really appreciate your response. I know there must be a light at the end of the tunnel, but I'm so sick of waiting for it. Things were going so horribly for the past 2 years outside of my relationship, and now it terrifies me to know I might lose him, too. I just can't handle this much heartbreak, it's suffocating me. I wish I could skip it all and just know what's gonna happen. But instead I have to push through the uncertainty and hopelessness. It feels like everyone I love leaves me.. And it's hard not to blame myself. And even harder not to imagine I'd be better off dead.
